title: BARTENDER Glass of God
description: At Eden Hall, each glass has a story. A quiet bar lies tucked away in the streets of Tokyo, and it seems only the most desperate souls burdened by their own troubles manage to find its doors. But after a glass of God poured by the brilliant bartender Ryu, they leave renewed. Ryu has a gift—he knows how to soothe the soul with the perfect drink. Who will he meet next?

episodes.title: S1-E4A Bar's Secret Ingredient / The Face of a Martini

episodes_data.title: BARTENDER Glass of God Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: The workers of the Business Planning Division for Hotel Cardinal are desperate to find a bartender. The chairman has declared that they must find someone capable of making the "Glass of God." This is no simple task when they have no idea what that means.

episodes_data.title: BARTENDER Glass of God Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Ryu encounters an impossibly difficult-to-please customer while he's helping out at another bar. When a foul-mouthed customer wanders into Edenhall, Ryu will have to think outside the box and even the bar to serve her.

episodes_data.title: BARTENDER Glass of God Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Award-winning bartender Kuzuhara Ryuichi finds himself in an impromptu bartending competition with Sasakura Ryu at the prodding of Chairman Taizo. A young woman comes to Edenhall, determined to see how Ryu mixes a B&B.

episodes_data.title: BARTENDER Glass of God Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Desperate to recruit a chef of French cuisine with unreasonable standards, Kamishima turns to Ryu for help. Kyoko returns to Edenhall for bartending advice once again. This time, Ryu takes her to a bar he visited as an apprentice.

episodes_data.title: BARTENDER Glass of God Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Ryu, Kyoko, Yuri, Miwa, and Chen get together to visit the "holy ground of Japanese whisky," Yamazaki Distillery. While they're there, they learn about Chen's past and his relationship to the area.

episodes_data.title: BARTENDER Glass of God Season 1 Episode 6
BARTENDER Glass of God Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: In the wake of the trip to Yamazaki Distillery, Chen decides he wants to spend his life as a bartender. However, his father is still determined to make him his heir. Chen turns to Ryu for help.

episodes_data.title: BARTENDER Glass of God Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: The Cocktail Award finals have come, and the bartenders have gathered to test their mettle. Each of the competitors brings not only their cocktails to compete but their stories as well.

episodes_data.title: BARTENDER Glass of God Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Miwa asks Ryu to accompany her to a bar, but when they stumble into another one on accident, Ryu encounters someone very important from his past.

episodes_data.title: BARTENDER Glass of God Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Miwa continues to worry about Ryu and how he's coping with the death of one of his previous customers. Hayase receives another promotion that will put him in America for a few years, but when Rumi comes back to town, he hesitates to leave.

episodes_data.title: BARTENDER Glass of God Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Kase is temporarily discharged from the hospital for what will likely be the last time. He's determined to stand behind the counter one last time, and his proteges are willing to do everything in their power to make that happen.

episodes_data.title: BARTENDER Glass of God Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Kurosawa Junichiro has holed up at Hotel Cardinal in order to finish writing the manuscript for his next highly anticipated novel. Ryu decides to finally accept Taizo's offer, but he has one condition that must be fulfilled first.
